recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The main FHIR-14370 narrative removal remains historically applied, and this narrow current-source change removes the only remaining Provenance wording that could be mistaken for the removed userId element.
issue_request: FHIR-14370 was a Published/Persuasive Security WG change request for STU3 asking that Provenance section 6.3.4.4, "Party References", be rewritten or removed because userId and redundant URL reference elements were gone; the final resolution was to remove the defunct section.
initial_application: Historical commit df8241d8ed19f08b12c18f34bf71c7bdbf611ef9 explicitly included GF#14370 and removed the Party References section from source/provenance/provenance-notes.xml. Related earlier commit f72fd6237875c6ba9d2a21e235881c7fed559700 applied FHIR-13570 Reference-definition work by moving Provenance source away from URI/userId-style choices toward Identifier/Reference choices.
additional_context: Provenance is active in source/fhir.ini and provenance-example-sig is listed as a current Provenance example. Later FHIR-15659 work simplified Provenance.agent.who into the current Reference-based model, so the old whoIdentifier/whoReference split should not be restored. Community searches found no substantive Zulip or Confluence discussion beyond a bot tracker notification.
reconciliation: Changed only source/provenance/provenance-example-sig.xml, replacing the stale camelCase "userId" comment wording with "user identifier" and correcting the same sentence's spelling. The example's actual Provenance.agent.who.identifier structure was already correct and was left unchanged.
source_changes: source/provenance/provenance-example-sig.xml: changed a visible XML comment from "userId" to "user identifier" above Provenance.agent.who.identifier.

related_jiras.note: Clarified Provenance Identifier/Reference choices in STU3 and made the old Party References section obsolete; used as context, not separately decided.

Parallel AuditEvent issue removing a redundant userId pattern; consistent background but outside the Provenance seed decision.
